note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The correct answer asks who controls access and obtains the written release before any work. Urgency and keys do not replace verification.
Only a written release from the controlling authority, with its scope, supports work. Keys and verbal permission are not a release.

practicalCriteria: The learner identifies who controls access and what has been formally released, and refuses work where the release is missing or unclear.
The learner separates keys and verbal permission from a written release.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: No written release from the controlling authority, or the release is unclear.
Any pressure to start on keys or verbal permission.
